title: AccordionItem configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.AccordionItemAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

Icon.description: Indicator icon: Caret, PlusMinus or Custom (a developer-supplied icon in the item's icon placeholder).

IconPosition.description: Side of the title where the indicator icon is rendered (left or right).

IsDisabled.description: Prevents the user from expanding or collapsing the item.

StartsExpanded.description: Renders the item already expanded when it is built.

ToggleWithIcon.description: When true only the icon toggles the item; otherwise the whole title area does.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
